export.footnoteMissing: Note: a day with no data means its statistics are not published yet. The cells are left blank and are not counted as 0 in any total.
export.footnoteNoSplit: Note: on days without a payment split, revenue does not reconcile with the POS payment records (older-system data has no payment breakdown, or statistics have not yet caught up with late-uploaded orders). Revenue is still counted; card, cash and other are left blank and the totals of those three columns exclude these days.
